US.summary:
* **QURE** - Reported a Q2 net loss missing estimates alongside higher-than-expected revenue of $5.8 million.
* **RKLB** - Secured a 3-mission contract with iQPS, driving a 10.38% share rally.
* **META** - Shares dropped 8-10% on an EPS miss, lower free cash flow, and raised 2026 AI CapEx guidance to $130B–$145B.
* **iShares Gold Trust (IAU)** - Gold prices rebounded to ~$4,096 on soft inflation data and a weaker US dollar.
* **Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS)** - Faced an FTC lawsuit alleging unauthorized health data sharing and deceptive billing.
* **Zscaler, Inc. (ZS)** - Shares declined amid a slower growth outlook and an updated MarketBeat price target.
* **BioNTech SE (BNTX)** - Received European Commission marketing authorization for its XFG variant-targeted COVID-19 vaccine.
* **Johnson & Johnson (JNJ)** - Secured FDA Priority Review and a major Sail Biomedicines deal amid ongoing litigation pressures.
* **ORCL** - Announced an expanded Google Cloud partnership for Gemini AI integration, lifting shares ~8.4%.
* **Bloom Energy Corporation (BE)** - Surged 25.25% following a Mizuho upgrade to Outperform with a $242 price target.
* **Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (MRAAY)** - Released Q1 2027 financial results.
* **Amkor Technology, Inc. (AMKR)** - Suffered a 36% five-day losing streak despite a major stake increase by Sei Investments.
* **Qnity Electronics, Inc. (Q)** - Disclosed new and expanded institutional positions by Renaissance Technologies and HOOPP.
* **Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. (VSH)** - BlackRock reported a 15.0% beneficial ownership stake via a Schedule 13G/A filing.
* **WOLF** - Shares surged 17.7% to ~$23.62 in heavy trading.
* **Sandisk Corporation (SNDK)** - Surged 21.5% to 26% amid an AI infrastructure-driven semiconductor rally.
* **RGEN** - Received a price target increase to $185 from Wells Fargo alongside an Overweight rating.

INDIA.summary:
* **LAURUSLABS** - Hit a new 52-week high, trading in the range of ₹1,781–₹1,785.
* **TDPOWERSYS** - Experienced sharp downward momentum, hitting an intraday low of ₹930 (-10.28%).
* **MTARTECH** - Reported Q1 FY27 net profit surged 364.5% YoY to ₹50.2 crore on a 130.4% rise in revenue, alongside an amended purchase order bringing total contract value to ~₹3,100 crore.
* **PRIVISCL** - Disclosed Q1 FY27 results with consolidated net profit up 35.98% YoY to ₹84.21 crore and revenue up 19.22% YoY.
* **Concord Biotech Limited (CONCORDBIO)** - Registered a positive technical breakout after crossing above its 200-day moving average.
* **GRAVITA** - Announced the scheduled closure of its subsidiary, Gravita Metal Inc., on August 1, 2026.
* **Sheela Foam Limited (SFL)** - Released its Q1 earnings report.
* **EBGNG** - Reported Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit of ₹28.9 crore and revenue of ₹412 crore.
* **TANFACIND** - Shareholders approved a preferential issue of up to 4,24,647 equity shares and a new director appointment at the EGM.
* **CARYSIL** - Reported Q1FY27 results with a 9% YoY increase in total income to ₹5,252 crore and a 7% YoY rise in PAT to ₹3,120 crore.
* **INTERARCH** - Scheduled a board meeting to consider quarterly results and a potential stock split.
* **STEELCAS** - Board approved a ₹120 crore investment to establish a greenfield foundry with an 8,500-ton capacity.
* **Neogen Chemicals Limited (NEOGEN)** - Announced August 13, 2026, as the record date for its final dividend and AGM voting.
* **SYNGENE** - Reported a Q1 FY27 standalone net loss and 17% revenue decline due to forex losses, sending the stock to a new 52-week low.
* **STLTECH** - Shares fell ~4% following earnings despite management raising FY27 EBITDA margin guidance to 23%.
